title: vmup
subtitle: GCP Instance Manager
description: A single-binary TUI for launching and managing Google Cloud compute instances. vmup provisions VMs with Terraform, opens SSH tunnels over IAP, and wraps it all in an interactive terminal UI — no manual setup required.

title: IRIS-RCC Portal
subtitle: Renal Cell Carcinoma Subtyping
description: A web portal for the IRIS-RCC predictor. Researchers upload a TPM gene-expression matrix and get renal cell carcinoma transcriptional cluster assignments back. A companion Nextflow pipeline handles the upstream half, taking RNA-seq reads from raw FASTQ files to the TPM matrix the portal expects.

title: GeneFox
subtitle: Cancer Genomics Browser
description: A native mobile and desktop browser for public cancer-genomics data. Explore 60+ GDC cohorts, 40,000+ NCBI GEO datasets, GTEx, UCSC Xena, and CCLE — or your own expression matrices — with stratified expression plots, Kaplan–Meier survival, volcano plots, clustered heatmaps, and signature scoring. Statistics and figures are computed on your device, with no ads, accounts, or tracking.
